jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist / Internal Recruiter (13-Month Fixed-Term Contract — Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
NMI is looking for a motivated and experienced Internal Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team on a 13\-month fixed\-term contract, providing maternity leave cover. This is a fantastic opportunity to play a hands\-on role in shaping our teams during a period of continued growth.



The primary focus of this role will be recruiting for our global Support, Sales and Marketing organisations — critical functions that keep NMI's partners and customers at the heart of everything we do. Alongside this, you'll have the opportunity to recruit across multiple lines of business, giving you broad exposure to the variety of talent needs across the company.



We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, brings strong sourcing instincts, and can hit the ground running. Whether your background is in agency recruitment, in\-house talent acquisition, or a blend of both — if you're passionate about finding great people, we'd love to hear from you.



This is a 100% remote opportunity for candidates based in the United Kingdom. While there is no requirement to work from an office, team members are always welcome to visit our Bristol office for in\-person collaboration, internal events, holiday parties, and other opportunities to connect with colleagues.


**Please note:** This is a fixed\-term contract position (13 months). The benefits package for this role differs from those offered to permanent employees and is outlined below.


### **About NMI**



NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one\-size\-fits\-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.


### **How We Work \- Our Core Values**


* **Be a Good Person, It's Simple.** We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
* **Align, Trust \& Go.** We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together \- holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
* **Raise the Bar.** Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Own the end\-to\-end recruitment process for roles across the global organisation, from intake through to offer acceptance.
* Manage a live requisition load of open roles simultaneously, maintaining momentum and quality across the full portfolio.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to define role requirements, agree sourcing strategies, and ensure alignment on candidate profiles and timelines.
* Proactively source and engage passive candidates through platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other creative channels.
* Build and maintain a healthy, diverse pipeline of candidates across all markets.
* Champion and represent NMI's culture, values, and employer brand throughout every candidate interaction.
* Conduct thorough initial screenings and coordinate interview processes, ensuring a seamless and positive candidate experience from first contact through to offer.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and use recruitment data to inform decisions and report on progress.
* Provide regular updates to hiring managers and Talent Acquisition leadership on requisition status, pipeline health, and market insights.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of recruitment processes, tools, and practices.

### **Essential Skills \& Experience:**


* 2\+ years of recruiting experience in an in\-house and/or agency setting.
* Proven ability to manage multiple open requisitions concurrently, balancing speed and quality.
* Strong direct sourcing skills with demonstrated experience engaging passive candidates.
* Experience recruiting across multiple functions or business areas.
* Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems and tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build credibility with hiring managers at all levels.
* Highly organised with strong prioritisation and time management skills.
* A data\-informed mindset — you track your metrics, spot trends, and use insights to improve outcomes.
* Sound understanding of confidentiality and ethical recruitment practices.

### **Preferred Skills \& Experience:**


* Experience recruiting for customer support, marketing and sales functions in a global or multi\-site environment.
* Familiarity with recruiting in the payments, fintech, or SaaS industry.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
We have a fantastic opportunity for an experienced and commercially minded HR Business Partner to join our Senior Leadership Team. This role will be remote with national travel and ideally based in the Midlands/North.

  

The HR Business Partner will act as a trusted adviser and coach to leaders, helping to develop management capability, strengthen leadership effectiveness and embed a culture of accountability, performance and continuous improvement. The role combines strategic business partnering with practical operational support, ensuring that people initiatives align with organisational objectives and contribute to improved business performance.

  

As a key member of the Regional Leadership Team, you will influence decision\-making, shape workforce strategies and lead the implementation of people initiatives that support growth, colleague engagement, service excellence and organisational effectiveness.

 **Benefits for the role include**

  

* Competitive Salary
* Annual car allowance
* Annual 10% Performance related bonus
* Private Healthcare
* 33 days annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays) with the option to purchase additional leave through salary sacrifice
* Life Assurance
* 24/7 online/telephone GP Consultation and access to prescriptions.
* 2nd opinion medical support following diagnosis or where a colleague is on a treatment pathway.
* Cash\-plan benefits, providing colleagues the option of protecting themselves in case of illness and recuperation, including dental, optical, chiropody.
* Access to mental health and physiotherapy consultations.
* Access to legal advice on domestic issues e.g. motoring offences, wills and probate, and personal injury.
* Long Service Recognition Scheme – recognising colleagues for their continued service after 5 years and at 5\-year intervals with an increase in annual leave.

  


**Role Responsibilities**

  

* Partner with Regional Directors and leadership teams to develop and deliver regional people plans that support operational, commercial and organisational objectives.
* Provide strategic HR advice on business planning, organisational development, workforce transformation and growth.
* Ensure people considerations are embedded in regional decision\-making and operational planning.
* Use workforce data, trends and insight to identify organisational risks, opportunities and targeted interventions.
* Lead and support organisational change, restructures, acquisitions, contract mobilisations and TUPE transfers.
* Coach, mentor and constructively challenge leaders to improve their confidence and effectiveness in managing people.
* Build capability in performance management, attendance, wellbeing, employee relations, talent development and colleague engagement.
* Identify leadership capability gaps and implement practical, measurable development solutions.
* Design and facilitate leadership workshops, management training and development interventions.
* Promote a culture in which managers take ownership and accountability for leading, developing and engaging their teams.
* Provide expert guidance on complex employee relations matters, ensuring compliance with employment legislation, organisational policy and good practice.
* Work collaboratively with specialist People colleagues to mitigate legal, employee relations, financial and reputational risk.
* Lead and support workforce planning, succession planning and talent management activity across the region.
* Drive colleague engagement activity and ensure feedback is translated into clear and meaningful action.
* Help embed a positive, inclusive and high\-performance culture aligned with EMED values and behaviours.
* Build credible and productive relationships with operational leaders, senior stakeholders, employee representatives and trade unions.
* Influence decisions at senior level through clear advice, professional expertise and constructive challenge.
* Represent the People Function at Regional Leadership Team meetings and operational forums.
* Support client presentations, bids, contract mobilisations and business development activity where appropriate.
* This role supports a geographically dispersed operational workforce and requires a significant and consistent regional presence. The successful candidate will: Travel regularly throughout the designated region to support operational locations and management teams.
* Spend time in operational environments to understand local challenges and identify effective people solutions.
* Attend regional and national meetings, leadership events, workshops and project activity. Undertake occasional overnight stays where business needs require.
* Success in the role will be assessed through agreed objectives and measures, including: Delivery and impact of regional people plans.

  


**Do you have what it takes?**

  


* CIPD Level 5 qualification or above, or equivalent professional experience.
* Significant experience operating as an HR Business Partner within a complex, multi\-site organisation.
* A proven record of strategic business partnering with senior operational leaders.
* Strong coaching and leadership development experience, with evidence of building management capability.
* Extensive knowledge of UK employment law and employee relations practice.
* Experience of leading and supporting organisational change and transformation.
* Demonstrable commercial awareness and the ability to connect people priorities with business outcomes.
* Experience of working in a unionised environment.
* Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
* The ability to interpret people data and turn insight into practical, targeted action.

  


**Desirable**

  

* Chartered CIPD membership.
* Experience within healthcare, emergency services, logistics, transport or another operationally intensive sector.
* Experience supporting large, geographically dispersed workforces.
* Experience of TUPE transfers, bids and contract mobilisat
